subject: UNLOCK statement
notes: kb/Work PB345 (landed); PB360 (open, on the missing-connector arm of FileRegistry.Unlock, which this file connector no longer reaches). RULE: 'File-name-1 shall reference a file connector in the open mode.' - cite.py --check 14.9.47.4 'File-name-1 shall reference a file connector in the open mode.' -> OK 14.9.47.4 2). The consequence of violating it is named by 9.1.13.7 item 2, 'I-O status = 42. A CLOSE or UNLOCK statement is attempted for a file connector that is not in an open mode.' The golden's U1 line seeds FILE STATUS with 'ZZ' and then UNLOCKs a CLOSED record-description-less RELATIVE connector, measuring 42; U2 UNLOCKs the same connector while OPEN and measures 00. Before PB345 that connector was never registered and the statement aborted the run unit instead of setting a status.
